Step.SQLStatement: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW RV_ForecastFact AS -- Invoice Lines SELECT ff.M_ForecastFact_ID, ff.AD_Client_ID, ff.AD_Org_ID, ff.M_ForecastComparison_ID, fc.ComparisonSource, ff.AD_Table_ID, ff.Record_ID, ff.DateDoc, il.M_Product_ID, il.LineNetAmt, il.QtyInvoiced AS Qty, i.DocumentNo, ff.IsActive, ff.Created, ff.Updated FROM M_ForecastFact ff JOIN M_ForecastComparison fc ON (fc.M_ForecastComparison_ID = ff.M_ForecastComparison_ID) JOIN C_InvoiceLine il ON (il.C_InvoiceLine_ID = ff.Record_ID) JOIN C_Invoice i ON (i.C_Invoice_ID = il.C_Invoice_ID) WHERE ff.AD_Table_ID = 333 UNION ALL -- Order Lines SELECT ff.M_ForecastFact_ID, ff.AD_Client_ID, ff.AD_Org_ID, ff.M_ForecastComparison_ID, fc.ComparisonSource, ff.AD_Table_ID, ff.Record_ID, ff.DateDoc, ol.M_Product_ID, ol.LineNetAmt, ol.QtyOrdered AS Qty, o.DocumentNo, ff.IsActive, ff.Created, ff.Updated FROM M_ForecastFact ff JOIN M_ForecastComparison fc ON (fc.M_ForecastComparison_ID = ff.M_ForecastComparison_ID) JOIN C_OrderLine ol ON (ol.C_OrderLine_ID = ff.Record_ID) JOIN C_Order o ON (o.C_Order_ID = ol.C_Order_ID) WHERE ff.AD_Table_ID = 260 UNION ALL -- InOut Lines (Shipment/Receipt) SELECT ff.M_ForecastFact_ID, ff.AD_Client_ID, ff.AD_Org_ID, ff.M_ForecastComparison_ID, fc.ComparisonSource, ff.AD_Table_ID, ff.Record_ID, ff.DateDoc, iol.M_Product_ID, 0 AS LineNetAmt, iol.MovementQty AS Qty, io.DocumentNo, ff.IsActive, ff.Created, ff.Updated FROM M_ForecastFact ff JOIN M_ForecastComparison fc ON (fc.M_ForecastComparison_ID = ff.M_ForecastComparison_ID) JOIN M_InOutLine iol ON (iol.M_InOutLine_ID = ff.Record_ID) JOIN M_InOut io ON (io.M_InOut_ID = iol.M_InOut_ID) WHERE ff.AD_Table_ID = 320;
